mg_myrelis_andor.m: No, I'm sorry, but you are the first human that I've seen in...geez, I can't even remember how long.

mg_myrelis_barricades_10.m: [With a terrified expression on his face] Oh those? Yeah, you don't want to go past those. Past them is the entrance to Undertell.
r: Oh, that's how to get to Undertell?! How do I get past those barricades?

mg_myrelis_illusion_10.m: So, what did you think of my work?
r: Why did you build that here?
We've already discussed it. Don't you remember?
I was wondering, why are those barricades there? [pointing southwest]
How do I get past those barricades?
I am wondering if you could help me, I am looking for something.

mg_myrelis_illusion_what_was_that_20.m: Ah, my finest creation! A scene to dazzle the senses, to remind even the most weary traveler of life's beauty. I call it "Tropical Bliss." But enough about what it is. What did it make you feel? Awe? Peace? Perhaps a longing for adventure?

mg_myrelis_illusion_why_build_that_10.m: Let me tell you a little story. Long ago, I was an indentured servant, toiling away as a miner here in Galmore. This place was a prison to my spirit, a bleak and joyless pit. When I was freed, I swore I would transform it. I wanted to create something that could transport others to a place of happiness and light, even if just for a moment. That beach is the opposite of this wretched place.
r: I see. Thank you for telling me your story.
Interesting! Very, but I have another question.

mg_myrelis_illusion_you_did_that_10.m: No, no, no. An artist never reveals the "how." The methods are nothing compared to the grandeur of the art itself. Let's not tarnish the magic by pulling back the curtain, shall we?
r: Why did you build that here?

mg_myrelis_shannal_10.m: To enter Undertell, you need to talk to my friend Shannal, she has just come to spend a day at the beach. Shannal is the guardian ghost who controls passage to Undertell. Only she can remove (and put back) the barriers you see now.
r: You, Shannal, maybe other ghosts, you all sure can affect the world of the living. Why does Shannal control the passage to Undertell?

mg_myrelis_shannal_20.m: She has seen horrors, as have the rest of us. It moved something inside her. When she came back as a ghost, that change gave her the ability to barricade the entrance, which she has. Go see her.

r: I'm looking for some place called "Undertell", do you know where it is?
I'm looking for my brother. His name is Andor and he looks a lot like me.

mg_myrelis_undertell_20.m: With a terrified expression on his face, Myrelis slowly raises his arm and points you to the southwest.

mg_myrelis_undertell_30.m: Over there, but it looks like it's blocked.
r: How do I get past those barricades?
Do you know of Vaelric, the healer?

mg_myrelis_vaelric_20.m: Vaelric... Hmm, the name does tickle a memory, but I can't place it. I've heard whispers, perhaps, or seen his name scrawled in some dusty tome. Why do you ask? Is he another artist, or just someone you are curious about?
r: Oh, never mind. I was just wondering.

mg_myrelis_vaelric_5.m: Sorry. You see, ghosts sometimes have bad memories. Or is it just me? Anyway, if we already talked, then why are you back here?
r: Do you know of Vaelric, the healer?
I'm wondering if you could help me? I'm looking for something.

undertell_barricades.10: I asked Myrelis how to get the barricades to Undertell removed and he told me to meet his friend Shannal inside the beach-scene house.
undertell_barricades.20: I met Shannal and she said I had to prove myself before she would remove the barriers. She feared that I am not ready to enter Undertell.
undertell_barricades.40: Shannal gave me a special Traders' Guild bronze coin and asked me to show it to Benbyr north of Fallhaven.
undertell_barricades.60: A frightened Benbyr told me these coins were payments his ancestor received for kidnapping people to work in the mines of Undertell.
undertell_barricades.70: Benbyr asked me to help save him from Shannal.
undertell_barricades.80: Shannal told me she did not want to kill Benbyr. She wanted him to pay toward helping her descendant, the drunkard named Rain who sleeps outside the Fallhaven Tavern.
undertell_barricades.90: Shannal asked me to help cure Rain by giving him one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses and whatever I can get of value from Benbyr. But I should visit Benbyr first.
undertell_barricades.100: Benbyr offered me fifty gold to keep the matter quiet. I refused.
undertell_barricades.110: Benbyr then offered 500 gold. I still refused.
undertell_barricades.120: Benbyr became terrified and handed over 5000 gold.
undertell_barricades.130: I gave one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses to drunkard outside the Fallhaven tavern, and he remembered his time in Undertell.
undertell_barricades.140: I assured Rain that Shannal was at peace and gave him the 5000 gold Benbyr had given me. He told me to keep the money safe with Bela until his hangover passed.
undertell_barricades.150: I entrusted 4850 gold to Bela for safekeeping. She agreed to hold it.
undertell_barricades.160: Shannal thanked me for helping Rain and warned me to be careful. She removed the barricades in front of the entrance to Undertell.

swamp_healer.10: I encountered Vaelric, a reclusive healer living in the swamp between Mt. Galmore and Stoutford. He refused to help me unless I dealt with a dangerous creature corrupting his medicinal pools.
swamp_healer.20: I defeated the monstrous creature that I found on Vaelric's land. This creature was enormous and venomous, feeding on the lifeblood of the swamp.
swamp_healer.30: Vaelric rewarded me for my efforts by teaching me how to use leeches to heal bleeding wounds. He warned me to save them for dire situations and respect their power.

nocmar.10: Unnmir told me he used to be an adventurer, and gave me a hint to go see Nocmar. His house is just southwest of the tavern in Fallhaven.
nocmar.20:
Nocmar tells me he used to be a smith. But Lord Geomyr has banned the use of heartsteel, so he cannot forge his weapons anymore.
If I can find a heartstone and bring it to Nocmar, he should be able to forge the heartsteel again.
nocmar.30: Nocmar, the Fallhaven smith, said that I could find a heartstone in a place called Undertell which is somewhere near Galmore Mountain.
nocmar.35: Myrelis, the ghost artist I met in the Galmore encampment, informed me that the entrance to Undertell is located just southwest of his building.
nocmar.40: I discovered the heartstone deep inside Undertell, but it was far too hot to move or even touch. Maybe Unnmir knows what I should do next?
nocmar.45: I discovered a heartstone deep inside Undertell. It's time to put Nocmar to work.
nocmar.48: Nocmar informed me that I must return the unrefined heartstone back to where I found it so it could "become whole".
nocmar.50: Unnmir told me that the only way to cool the heartstone enough to carry it is to use a block of Galmore ice which he said I could find at the top of Galmore Mountain guarded by the snow beasts. This rare ice does not melt in the lowlands, only when placed against something extremely hot like lava or the heartstone itself.
nocmar.60: I was spooked by a sound causing me to lose my grip on the unrefined heartstone, causing me to drop it. Thus shattering it into pieces.
nocmar.70: I placed the Galmore ice on the heartstone. The block hissed and steamed as it melted away, cooling the heartstone until it was safe to touch. I picked it up at last.
nocmar.80: I returned to Nocmar with the cooled heartstone. He was eager to begin his work, but... not in his Fallhaven shop.
nocmar.90: Nocmar told me to meet him at the glowing white house south of Fallhaven. He says the lock will no longer bar my entry, as he must prepare the forge and make sure the place is safe.
nocmar.100: I met Nocmar inside the glowing white house, where the ever-burning forge waits. He explained that with the heartstone I recovered, he can forge one heartsteel weapon of my choice.
nocmar.110: As I refused a heartsteel weapon from Nocmar, Falkour, the forge dragon beneath the glowing house, gifted me a pendant.
nocmar.200: Nocmar forged the heartsteel once again and rewarded me with a weapon type of my choice, reforged in the lost art.
